title: Repair known spell projection losses and selected spell capability inputs
description:
Repair demonstrated spell projection defects such as area/origin geometry,
projectile/count/target relationships, ordered pools/allocation, multi-stage/repeat
effects, termination, upcast bases, successful-save branches, and known source
anomalies. Do not compile every spell into a deterministic clause-complete procedure.
design:
2026-10-10 DESIGN (Claude Captain, main f3ca1b6e). Lane A, profile rules-clause-complete. Consumers: discovery/packet.ts projectionLimits emits 'The source describes an area, but no typed mechanics.area projection exists.' when area prose has no typed area (read-only consumer; notes disappear as areas are typed). The in-force spell upcast capability (spellUpcastContract.ts; upcast.ts count-per-slot) encodes only the per-slot INCREMENT for projectile counts, so the base count is a source projection, not a capability input.
A1 POINT-ORIGIN AND OTHER AREAS (opus:F-08 / fable:F2): only 16 spells type mechanics.area, all origin 'self'. Snapshot: 46 spells describe an area of effect in prose only (e.g. fireball '20-foot-radius sphere centered on a point you choose within range', cloudkill, circle-of-death, darkness, daylight, delayed-blast-fireball, earthquake ...). Population by query over spell descriptions: N-foot-radius sphere/cylinder (with height), N-foot cube, N-foot cone, line N feet long and N feet wide, N-foot radius / emanation. Extend the existing area shape: {shape: sphere|cylinder|cube|cone|line|radius|hemisphere, size (radius or edge or length), height? (cylinder), width? (line), unit:'foot', origin: 'self' | 'point-within-range' | 'creature' | 'object' (from the printed anchor: 'centered on a point you choose within range', 'centered on you', 'centered on a creature/object'), }. Project ONLY when the sentence defines the spell's area of effect; a dimension describing something else (an object's size, a warded area that is not an effect area?) is reported, not projected. Every projected value must occur in the sentence. Report the full population with projected/not-projected and reason; validate shapes/origins in kindSchemas (fail closed). Check every consumer of mechanics.area (grep) before changing.
A2 BASE PROJECTILE COUNT (opus:F-11): spell:magic-missile projects per-dart damage and the upcast increment but not 'You create three glowing darts of magical force'. Add mechanics.projectiles {count: N, noun: '<printed noun>'} (e.g. {count:3, noun:'dart'}) from the printed creation sentence. Sibling population by query: 'create(s) N <noun>' / 'hurl N <noun>' / 'N rays/beams' (scorching ray three rays; eldritch blast scales by character level - its count comes from the cantrip-scaling sentence; project only the printed base 'a beam' -> count 1 only if the existing scaling projection represents the level steps, otherwise leave and report). Report each.
REGISTRY: point-origin-areas (F-08/fable:F2) and magic-missile-projectiles (F-11) stay accepted with repair reasoning; spell-completeness (indep:005) and spell-mechanics-depth (sol:CAP-003) -> narrowed under ADR 0020 (surviving obligation: emitted spell projections agree with source; unprojected semantics stay verbatim and model-adjudicated, never implied complete).
EVIDENCE: one new test file: generalized invariant that every spell whose description prints an area-defining phrase (independent regex in the test, same population) has a typed area whose shape/size/origin match the phrase, OR is in an explicit reviewed not-an-effect-area list with a reason; exact fireball, cloudkill, magic-missile cases; projectile siblings exact.
acceptance_criteria:
- Known spell projection findings are repaired with source-grounded regressions.
- Stable source structures may be exhaustively typed only over independently justified structural families.
- Generic metadata cannot serve as evidence that a spell's whole procedure is implemented.
- Pack data consumed by a capability in force is source-faithful; that capability's contract, execution, and state evidence belong to the capability lane (eshyra-o9bd.19.5 / eshyra-olc5).
- Unselected spell semantics remain discoverable/model-adjudicated rather than engine-pending by default.
